title: DAIP Phase 1 readiness review for written private-MVP design
implemented: Admin-only readiness workspace that reads Gate A and Gate B evidence.
Draft, paused, and exact-phrase readiness records with immutable audit events.
Server-side block: readiness cannot be authorized unless all twelve DAIP-0 decisions and all three Build 218 safety tests are ready.
RLS-protected service-role-only tables, responsive route copy, visual placeholder, service-worker cache coverage, guided test cases, and release guard.
explicitly_not_implemented: Storage, bucket, object key, upload, download, or signed-link capability
Worker, queue, FFmpeg, proxy, thumbnail, contact sheet, AI, transcription, vision, or rendering
Customer media, Gallery/Social/GBP/website handoff, public derivative, or automatic publishing
meaning_of_ready: Ready for a written private-MVP design review only. Gate C remains Held until a separate accepted technical build exists.
